title: Memory and retrieval: what the recipe library taught

cards.title: What you keep, and whether anyone uses it
cards.text: The simplest memory there is, a list of recipes and keyword search, built and measured.

cards.title: Each new read kept
cards.text: A proper recipe, field by field, its link still the site's.

cards.title: A source, not a cache
cards.text: The cook reads a copy from our own API, and 3 of 10 places stay for new pages.

cards.title: Measured empty and full
cards.text: From empty it failed the win test; full, 31 answers were built from a copy.

cards.title: What didn't work
cards.text: A memory nobody reads, made-up pages that hid bugs, and counts compared instead of checked.
